concerns.text: FR-003 (Labeling) and US-1 (Labeling logic) lack a concrete implementation task. Task T006 only defines the interface, and T015 (implementation) is marked as pending/unchecked. Without T015, the system cannot generate the 'is_buggy' label required by FR-003 and US-1.

FR-002 (Metric Extraction) requires calculating Cyclomatic Complexity and Halstead Volume. Tasks T014b (PMD wrapper) and T014c (Halstead wrapper) are marked as pending/unchecked. Without these, the specific metrics required by FR-002 cannot be computed.

FR-005 (Modeling) requires reporting mean ROC-AUC/F1 with standard deviation. Task T024 (Aggregation logic) is marked as pending/unchecked. Without T024, the system cannot calculate the required mean/std dev metrics.

FR-005 (Modeling) and SC-002 require handling class imbalance (zero-buggy projects). Task T025 (Handle class imbalance) is marked as pending/unchecked. This leaves a critical edge case defined in the spec unaddressed.
FR-005 and SC-002 require generating output reports. Task T026 (Generate correlation_report.json and baseline_metrics.json) is marked as pending/unchecked.
FR-007 (Feature Importance) requires extracting weights. Task T029 (Extract feature importance) is marked as pending/unchecked.

US-3 and FR-006 (Statistical Significance) require a Paired Permutation Test. Tasks T027 (Single Best Model), T030 (Collect predictions), T031 (Permutation Test), T032 (Ranking), and T033 (Significance Report) are all marked as pending/unchecked. The entire US-3 scope is unimplemented.
US-3 requires visualization. Task T034 (Viz bar chart) and T035 (Final Report) are marked as pending/unchecked.
US-1 Independent Test requires 'no nulls in numeric columns'. Task T018 (Validation for NaN) is marked as pending/unchecked, leaving the acceptance criteria unverified.

Plan.md 'Project Structure' and 'quickstart.md' requirements are not fully covered. Task T036 (quickstart.md) is pending. The plan explicitly requires quickstart.md as a Phase 1 output, but the task is in Phase 6 and unchecked.

Task T000a is marked as a prerequisite for all statistical tasks but is currently unchecked. While the plan acknowledges the constitutional conflict, the task to document the rationale (required to unblock execution per the plan) is not marked as complete, creating a logical gap in the 'Setup' phase readiness.
